**FAQ & support on our Discord:** https://discord.gg/D7AwRvu8U9

⚔️
  #  Step into the arena as royalty and settle disputes the only way tradition allows: SAUSAGE COMBAT. #

Wurst and Glory is the premier competitive dueling simulator for the noble athlete 👑 Every duel, you're offered 3 random sausages to wield. Pick one you've never used before, and it joins your arsenal.
[media]
🗡️ Master the physics of floppy meat combat, learn which sausage counters which, and collect every wobbly weapon in the arsenal.
[media]
🍅  Become the master of the banqueting hall: throw tomatoes at your opponent to blind their view, or use a pretzel as a shield. 🥨 
[media]

No skill trees ❌ No pay to win ❌ No microtransactions ❌ 
Just you, a rival noble, and whatever cured meat fate hands you this round.

**Duel for honor. Duel for glory. Duel with sausages.**
